## Example: href teleport-buttons

1. In [blender](https://blender.org) open your glTF-files (`world1.glb` e.g.)
2. create/select a cube
3. click the 'custom properties' tab
4. add a custom property (type string)
5. name it 'href' and set the value (`world2.glb` e.g.)
6. File > Export glTF (make sure to check the 'custom properties'-checkbox)

> more info: [create a teleport-button](https://xrfragment.org/#create%20a%20teleport%20button) and 
 [embedding href's](https://xrfragment.org/#How%20it%20works)
